necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indications of syncope and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as documented in the case facts.
